## Checklist

- [ ] The project is open source (or source-available, noted in the description) and has a public repository.
- [ ] I followed the format in [contributing.md](../contributing.md).
- [ ] The entry is in alphabetical order within its category.
- [ ] The description is short, starts with a capital letter and ends with a period.
- [ ] Non-OSI licences, archived or unmaintained projects are flagged in the description.
